title: 转肩看下一点
description: 成人低墙站稳后轻转肩部，看向近旁大把手。

art_direction.medium: linocut print with indigo shadows and ochre highlights
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult stands stably on two broad low footholds and turns the shoulder a little toward a nearby oversized handhold, with both hands still on secure grips. A clean diagonal composition leaves visual space toward the next hold and includes the empty mat below. Use risograph-inspired print design with limited coral and navy ink, grain within drawn forms, and intentional simplified silhouettes.
